title: Thomas D. Clark Center for Kentucky History

services.name: Facilities Rental
services.desc: The classically inspired Thomas D. Clark Center for Kentucky History can accommodate in style and grandeur groups both small and large. KHS can accommodate rental groups of up to 200 people (depending on the space that best suits your needs). Room amenities vary but include Wi-Fi, Ethernet, AV, teleconferencing capabilities, and dry-erase boards. KHS expects all events to harmonize with society’s character and mission. The Kentucky Historical Society reserves the right to decide whether an event is appropriate for our sites. Rentals are not available on Sundays. services.name: Guided tour
services.desc: We offer several options for a more in-depth experience when visiting the Kentucky Historical Society campus. Options include self-guided tours, daily guided tours, and guided group tours. Want to book a Field Trip? Visit our Field Trips page for more

services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Make, play, and investigate history at our signature week-long program for ages 6-12. Participants explore KHS exhibits, meet special guest speakers, collaborate with new friends, create art inspired by history, and engage in hands-on games and activities.
